root_idea.summary: The root centers on willing acceptance, contentment, and favorable approval, whether directed toward a person, thing, decree, or conduct.
root_idea.development: The lexical family extends from being pleased or approving to causing satisfaction, reciprocal agreement, passive pleasing, and intensified or divine approval; رضوان is described in the Quran-focused evidence as abundant approval, especially divine approval.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran form is the feminine inflection of the passive participial adjective مَرْضِيّ; it is represented under the normalized participial citation form.
The Quran occurrences are feminine forms of the active participial citation form رَاضٍ.
The exact Quranic form رَضِيّ is retained separately because the supplied lexical evidence does not securely equate it with another participial headword.

senses.definition: To be pleased with, content with, accept, or approve a person or thing.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with constructions such as رَضِيَ عَنْهُ, رَضِيَ عَلَيْهِ, رَضِيَهُ, and رَضِيَ بِهِ; the object may be a person or a thing.

senses.definition: Of God, to approve a servant and be well pleased with him on account of his obedience.
senses.usage_conditions: In divine-human formulations, divine approval is explained in relation to carrying out commanded acts and refraining from prohibited acts.

senses.definition: Of a servant, to be content with what God has decreed or with the recompense granted by Him.
senses.usage_conditions: This is the human side of the Quranic divine-human formula of reciprocal pleasure and approval.

senses.definition: To make someone pleased, content, or satisfied; to please or satisfy someone.
senses.usage_conditions: A causative construction taking the person pleased or satisfied as its object; it may also mean giving someone what will satisfy them.

senses.definition: To reach mutual agreement or consent; for each party to be pleased with or approve the arrangement.
senses.usage_conditions: A reciprocal construction describing agreement among two or more parties, often with ب or بينهم.

senses.definition: To approve, accept, or choose something or someone as suitable.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic uses concern approval or selection by a superior or authoritative subject.

senses.definition: Pleasure, approval, or the state of being pleased.
senses.usage_conditions: A verbal noun used in expressions concerning the pleasure or approval sought from another, especially in the Quranic contexts represented here.
A passive participial adjective applied to a person or thing regarded favorably; the feminine Quran form is included under this citation form.
An active participial adjective for one who is pleased with or approves something.
In the construction عِيشَةٌ رَاضِيَةٌ, the adjective describes a state or quality of life found pleasing rather than a subject experiencing pleasure.

senses.definition: Abundant or intensified pleasure and approval; in Quranic usage, especially divine pleasure.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran-focused evidence treats رضوان as a heightened form of رضا and particularly associates it with approval proceeding from God.

senses.definition: Mutual agreement, consent, or approval between parties.
senses.usage_conditions: A verbal noun denoting reciprocal satisfaction with an arrangement or transaction.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported extension of being pleased with something to selecting it in preference to alternatives.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Consent or permission, especially consent inferred from conduct.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In legal usage concerning a woman's consent to marriage, silence may testify to permission because permission indicates approval.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To surpass another in being pleased, content, or satisfied.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form I construction with a person as the object; its verbal noun is also related to مُرَاضَاة and رِضَاء.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To agree, consent, accord, or be of one mind with another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form III reciprocal-agreement construction is kept distinct from the Quran-attested Form VI entry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek to please, content, or satisfy someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form V construction can also describe pleasing or satisfying someone after effort or exertion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask, beg, or petition someone to please or satisfy one, or to provide what will satisfy one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form X request for another person's satisfaction or approval.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The name of an idol-temple associated with the tribe of Rabīʿah.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper-name use preserved as a distinct lexical item from the ordinary noun of contentment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The state of being pleased, content, satisfied, or approving; contentment or approval.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun also used substantivally, including in expressions meaning with someone's pleasure or approval.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pleasing or acceptable; a person or group with whom one is pleased.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An infinitive used adjectivally in the sense of a passive participle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The treasurer, keeper, or guardian of Paradise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical proper-title or personal-name use distinct from the Quranic abstract noun meaning abundant approval.
A reported Classical lexical use, given as synonymous with ضَامِنٌ; the evidence records a variant reading in some copies.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Loving, a lover, or a friend.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct Classical adjective or noun use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cause, means, or occasion of pleasure or approval.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived noun meaning something that brings about رضى, distinct from the verbal-noun sense of pleasure itself.

cautions: The Quranic form رَضِيًّا at 19:6 is retained as a separate public form, but the supplied lexical evidence does not securely assign its contextual gloss “pleasing” to that exact headword: the direct رَضِيّ entry supplies other Classical senses, while the explicit passive-participle explanation concerns مَرْضِيّ and مَرْضُوّ.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The QAC form group qac-form:rDw:raDiy~ at 19:6 is contextually glossed as “pleasing,” but no supplied Lane or Mufradat passage unambiguously explains that exact lexeme in this Quranic use. It is therefore displayed without an asserted numbered sense rather than assigning a meaning from the neighboring forms مَرْضِيّ or رَاضٍ.
